content:
name: Metrics report

on: [pull_request]

jobs:
    generate-report:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: read
        outputs:
            trusted-post-comment-script-available: ${{ steps.trusted_post_comment_script.outputs.available }}
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
            - run: corepack enable
            - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
            - uses: ./.github/actions/metrics-report
              with:
                  comment-body-path: metrics-report-comment.md
            - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
              with:
                  name: metrics-report-comment
                  path: metrics-report-comment.md
                  if-no-files-found: error
                  retention-days: 1
            - name: Check whether the base checkout can post comments
              id: trusted_post_comment_script
              env:
                  BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
              run: |
                  git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin "$BASE_SHA"

                  if git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:.github/actions/metrics-report/src/post-comment.mjs"; then
                    echo "available=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  else
                    echo "available=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                  fi

    post-comment:
        if: >-
            ${{
                github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
                needs.generate-report.outputs.trusted-post-comment-script-available == 'true'
            }}
        needs: generate-report
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        permissions:
            contents: read
            pull-requests: write
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
              with:
                  ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
                  persist-credentials: false
            - name: Use Node.js 24
              uses: actions/setup-node@v6
              with:
                  node-version: 24.18.1
                  package-manager-cache: false
            - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
              with:
                  name: metrics-report-comment
                  digest-mismatch: error
            - name: Post metrics report comment
              env:
                  COMMENT_BODY_PATH: metrics-report-comment.md
                  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
                  PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
              run: node .github/actions/metrics-report/src/post-comment.mjs
